name: Explore Cedofeita's Jazz Scene
description: For a more relaxed evening, wander through the bohemian Cedofeita district, dotted with cool bars offering live jazz and a laid-back atmosphere.
longDescription:
From May 21st to May 27th, 2026, the Cedofeita district of Porto hosts a week-long exploration of its local jazz offerings. This event highlights the independent bars and music venues within the area that regularly feature live jazz performances. It serves as an informal guide to the district's established nightlife scene, focusing on the musical contributions of local and regional jazz musicians.

Visitors can expect an evening atmosphere characterized by live music in various intimate settings. The experience is self-guided, allowing attendees to move between different establishments at their own pace. The audience typically comprises adults seeking a relaxed evening out, with performances generally taking place in Portuguese and English-speaking environments. Each venue maintains its distinct character, from cozy bars to slightly larger music rooms.

Access to individual venues typically involves varied pricing, with some establishments having a cover charge or minimum spend. Given the informal nature of the event, walk-ins are generally welcome at most locations. The Cedofeita district is centrally located and easily accessible; it is a short walk from Trindade metro station and served by several bus lines. Specific accessibility details will vary by individual venue.
